title: Disulfidptosis-associated signature in diabetic nephropathy: analysis code and results
description:
Analysis code, result tables and figures for a computational study of disulfidptosis-related transcriptional programs in diabetic nephropathy (DN). Four public transcriptomic datasets were integrated (GSE96804 training; GSE30528 and GSE30529 external validation; GSE131882 single-cell), and a seven-gene candidate signature (NCKAP1L, THSD7A, MYH10, PDLIM1, IL1B, FLNB, SLC3A2) was derived by intersecting LASSO, SVM-RFE and Random Forest selection with all feature selection re-executed inside each cross-validation fold. Internal validation used repeated 10x10-fold cross-validation (AUC 0.964), bootstrap optimism correction (corrected AUC 0.956) and permutation testing (P < 0.001); external validation gave AUC 0.923 in glomerular and 0.767 in tubulointerstitial samples.

The study's main biological result is a negative finding: oxidative stress, pentose phosphate and ferroptosis pathways were profoundly altered in DN, whereas disulfidptosis pathway activity itself was not (P = 0.953). The signature therefore reflects convergent actin cytoskeleton and oxidative stress perturbation rather than isolated disulfidptosis activation. Single-cell analysis localised the signature to biologically coherent compartments (THSD7A to podocytes, SLC3A2 to proximal tubular epithelium, NCKAP1L largely to immune cells).

The deposit contains the analysis scripts, all manuscript figures and result tables, and the manuscript itself. Raw and intermediate data are not included; they are reproducible from the GEO accessions listed in the repository.
